rules.statement: A co-owner should ordinarily be given by the commissioner an allotment which includes the improvements he has made, but this rule need not be adhered to if a fair and equitable division is rendered impossible.
rules.supporting_quote: "Although, according to section 33 of the Partition Act, a co-owner should ordinarily be given by the commissioner an allotment which includes the improvements he has made, this rule need not be adhered to if, in doing so, a fair and equitable division is rendered impossible."
